title.narrative: Technical Assistance for the Public Financial Management Capacity Development Programme for Improved Service Delivery Republic of South Africa

description.narrative: The National Treasury (NT) of South Africa fulfils a pivotal role in the implementation and management of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) No 1 of 1999 as well as the Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA) No 56 of 2003. In that context, a capacity development strategy for public finance management has been developed (2012) to overcome a complex array of challenges facing local government, provincial and national departments. The objective is to provide technical assistance that will contribute to the development of improved financial management capacity at the three spheres of the Government with a dedicated focus on local government (municipalities). Expected results are: 1.Increased Professionalization of Public Financial Management within all spheres of government (national, provincial and local)2.Enhanced Capacity of Provincial Treasuries to perform their roles with respect to provincial departments and municipalities3.Improve Capacity of municipalities to manage public funds and deliver services
